Measurement Units and Conversions: 1. 1 ft = 12 in, 2 ft = 24 in, 3 ft = 36 in, 4 ft = 48 in, 5 ft = 60 in. 2. 3,000 grams. 3. 400 centimeters. 4. 180 minutes. 5. 2 liters, because 2 liters = 2,000 milliliters, which is more than 1,800. 6. 21 feet. 7. Grams; meters; liters.
Garden Plans: Area and Perimeter: 1. Area 54 square feet; perimeter 30 feet. 2. 6 feet (72 ÷ 12). 3. 6 meters: 40 − 14 − 14 = 12, and 12 ÷ 2 = 6. 4. Possible rectangles: 11 by 1 (area 11), 10 by 2 (20), 9 by 3 (27), 8 by 4 (32), 7 by 5 (35), 6 by 6 (36). The rectangle closest to a square has the greater area. 5. 7 × $3 = $21; $25 − $21 = $4. 6. 7 × 25 = 175 minutes = 2 hours 55 minutes. 7. 10,000 grams = 10 kilograms; 10 ÷ 2 = 5 bags.
Line Plots: Bean Sprout Lengths: 1. Xs: 1 at 3/8, 2 at 4/8 (1/2), 3 at 5/8, 2 at 6/8 (3/4), 1 at 7/8, 1 at 1. 2. 5/8 inch. 3. 1 − 3/8 = 5/8 inch. 4. 7 sprouts. 5. 15/8 = 1 7/8 inches. 6. 3/4 + 3/4 + 1 = 2 2/4 inches (also 2 1/2).
Measurement and Data Check: 1. 72 inches. 2. 5,000 grams. 3. 135 minutes. 4. Area 112 square centimeters; perimeter 44 centimeters. 5. 9 meters. 6. 5:35 p.m. 7. 3 liters = 3,000 milliliters; 3,000 ÷ 250 = 12 cups. 8. Xs: 1 at 1/4, 2 at 1/2, 1 at 3/4, 2 at 1. Total of the 1/2-inch ribbons: 1 inch. Difference: 1 − 1/4 = 3/4 inch.
Scoring tip: on the precision criterion, a correct number without a unit, or area in plain units instead of square units, is Developing.
